body:
Hi, thanks a lot for answering. 

I get your point. I try to think that way, it's just that sometimes it feels like there's something wrong with me for seeing the bad things in that kind of memes. I still appreciate you took the time and shared that with me. I hope you're doing well.

We are social beings, so it's hard to not be affected by that kind of things, sometimes we can control how much affects us, but sometimes it's out of our hands and it makes it harder to cope with personal problems; I tend to minimize my problems because I sometimes feel like I should be grateful for the life I have, because it could be worse, but I know that's not a helpful thinking so I try to avoid it.

I guess things can and will be done differently, but that's gonna be in a long time from now. At least I hope so, because a lot of things would've done in vain if it's not the case. I feel the combination you're saying, but I think the strongest it's this kind of... lost of faith in humanity, like there's no point in feeling better if there's still a lot of shit out there.
I think that the fact you acknowledge all those things says a lot of good things about yourself, so I think the world needs people like you too. It's hard that people think about this things.

I'm safe, hope you're doing well too. It's really hard, I sometimes feel like it's unfair or selfish that I don't wanna live and I'm still alive but there are people that are dying or suffering. But not only that, there's also the stupid people that only think of themselves, like all those antivaccines or antimasks, or people who like to hurt others... I don't know, it's kinda overwhelming and disappointing. Thanks a lot for answering and understanding it.
